runtime.command_template: python -B tools/run_pinmame_harness.py --library <pinned-pinmame64.dll> --game corv_21 --rom-path <vpinmame-roms> --work-dir <new-isolated-state> --handle-mechanics 7 --scenario tools/harness-scenarios/wpc-security/cv-solenoid-test.json --dmd-dir <external-dmd-dir> --output <external-run.json>. Each Up press selects the next T.4 item; in repeat mode the ROM pulses it until the next press. The test walks 1-5, 7-19, 33 and 34 (skipping 6, offering 14 as NOT USED) and wraps to 1. A frame is taken while each press is held and 0.7 s after its settle; the later one is read.

raw_runs.nvram_initialization: empty; the run created its own isolated PinMAME state directory, so the ROM restored its factory settings before the scenario left the message loop with Escape

source.attribution: Generated locally from pinned PinMAME and the user-authorized ROM corpus; ROM bytes remain external. Public switch writes are host stimuli, never ROM observations. The runner can checkpoint only segment-display text, so the DMD service-menu navigation is counted pulses; every diagnostic snapshot's interpreted_text is the curator's visual reading of its retained DMD frame, identified by its pixel SHA-256. The exact external directory manifest (built by tools/build_external_evidence_manifest.py) lists the raw trace, the copied scenario, the DMD frames and the isolated mutable state, with no ROM bytes. Exact external directory manifest cv-solenoid-test/manifest.json SHA-256 9b2d03637c6e55a99aaf800bdd69530957dce31db7b242e335f00e9fe2c05c6d.
